Panoramic-surveillance override feedback: bit 00 is active-power override, set to 1 by a subarray command at 40430 and cleared to 0 when that command is cleared. Bit 01 similarly tracks reactive override at 40432. Bits 02–15 are reserved. Each meaningful bit uses 0 inactive and 1 overriding.

Sets aggregate active output for connected inverters and PCSs. Bounds are minus the combined PCS rated active power through the combined inverter-plus-PCS rated active power; out-of-range values are discarded. With ESS installed, a negative setpoint means power imported from the grid.
Sets aggregate reactive output for connected inverters and PCSs. Bounds are minus to plus their combined rated apparent power; out-of-range values are discarded.

Sets aggregate inverter/PCS active output as −100% to 100%. With ESS installed, a negative value requests power imported from the grid.
Sets aggregate inverter/PCS reactive output using power factor in (−1, −0.8] ∪ [0.8, 1]. The −1 endpoint is excluded.
Permitted active-power interval: minus combined PCS rated active power through combined inverter-and-PCS rated active power. Commands outside the interval are not executed.
Permitted reactive-power interval: minus to plus combined inverter-and-PCS rated apparent power. Commands outside the interval are not executed.
